scope: Requested seasonal source/terrain regressions using actual design ephemerides, retained GPU regression migration out of Bevy, neutral material codec ownership and explicit native raw material-storage fallback. No simulation/ephemeris/terrain law, new rendering effect or plume-form change.

seasonal_scenarios.source: Unmodified data/system.toml -> SystemConfig::bake -> CelestialPresentation::sample. Search 1025 host-year samples from -P/4 to 3P/4, then refine each seasonal distance extremum for 48 ternary steps. Thessa's moon motion and the moving BC barycentre are included; this is not an extremum of the full outer binary orbit.
seasonal_scenarios.far_visible: Farther seasonal Thessa-BC extremum, receiver on the star-facing hemisphere. B remains visible and its positive inverse-square irradiance reaches the actual regular/conforming terrain renderer; A remains visible too. No arbitrary opposed lamps or replacement ephemeris is installed.
seasonal_scenarios.a_hidden_b_visible: Nearer seasonal extremum roughly half Nereid's host year later, receiver on A's night hemisphere. A is completely occulted by Thessa, while B/C illuminate the surface and sky. Hiding A must not multiply all stellar illumination by zero.
seasonal_scenarios.negative_control: At far-season A-midnight both A and B are hidden: maximum observer-BC distance does not imply A and B are on opposite sides of the sky.
seasonal_scenarios.cpu_oracles: Shared solid-body clipping independently per source with no atmosphere, then nonzero B transmission at 8/16/32 samples through a fixed N2/O2 optical fixture. Hidden A transmission is exactly zero. With airglow disabled, A-night all-star single scattering equals B/C-only and remains nonzero. Actual B irradiance is lower at the farther extremum.
seasonal_scenarios.gpu_oracles: Actual regular and conforming sphere terrain at both ephemeris samples, fallback albedo (100,130,70)/255 linear, no ambient/specular/cloud/night-mask/auto-exposure. One fixed manual exposure across both seasons and all source-subset controls. B-only central linear RGBA8 agrees with independent Lambert evaluation within 2/255 per channel. A-night A-only is exactly dark; all-star equals B/C-only; reversing stellar slots preserves the central result.
seasonal_scenarios.camera: Body-frame 8,000,000 m eye radius, 3,200,000 m flat datum sphere, 65x65 linear Rgba8Unorm target, perspective near=10,000 m / far=100,000,000 m. Six submit/refinement iterations per control; only invariant central rays are compared, not independently refining conforming silhouettes.

material_boundary.codec: Existing EncodedMaterialLevel, four-plane RGBA encoder and reinterleave moved from MIT bevy-rcbt to existing MIT microstore-core::color. Bevy reexports/consumes the same implementation. No game-specific GPL content, page constructor, mip policy or residency is moved into the codec.
material_boundary.regression: Independent scalar per-channel encoding pins retained wire planes and code-level absolute-error bounds at 1x1, 3x5, 16x16 and 128x128, lossless and 2-code-level budgets. Invalid sizes/error budgets and mismatched plane extents are rejected. This is not a new linear-light error guarantee.
material_boundary.native_fallback: Capabilities::material_compact_supported expresses host residency support, separate from hardware codec support. Native Backend::resolve_graphics sets false: compact requests resolve to rgba_array with a diagnostic and correct applied metadata, without mutating requested settings or adding compact encode/decode/cache work. Legacy reports true and retains its path; unknown pre-init support keeps previous provisional resolution.
material_boundary.no_win_claim: Native residency remains the existing bounded raw MaterialArray. No native compression gain, reduced GPU memory, faster frame or improved landscape appearance is claimed.

retained_gpu_migration.coverage: 25 retained shader/material/cloud-optics tests, including real page mips, CPU/GPU compact decode, cube-face material addressing, dirty geometry, f64 chart precision, classifier history, cloud transport/quadrature/continuity and a compute surrogate for mesh emission. Shader text and fixture inputs remain their existing shared owners, including the retained cloud_volume.wesl asset; this does not newly certify native cloud parity.
retained_gpu_migration.newly_admitted_test: Mesh-emission compute surrogate no longer depends on the old mesh-shaders feature. First run exposed stale exact-string deletion of the raster vertex wrapper after conforming support had extended its body. The shim now strips only stage attributes, preserving the current helper body, production bindings, fan-out and checked output. This is not native mesh-stage execution.
retained_gpu_migration.remaining: Bevy scheduling/extraction/residency adapter tests and the legacy runnable host are retained. Final Bevy deletion and complete renderer replacement remain unfinished.

limitations: Seasonal tests isolate body centre-ray visibility, direct diffuse terrain and clear-sky single scattering, not a full-frame rendered source-disc oracle or independent aesthetic acceptance
No partial-disc stellar limb/eclipses, Nereid or other-body occluders, multi-star city-mask gating or calibrated production atmosphere certification
Native compact material residency and packed material-shader sampling remain unavailable; explicit raw fallback is not a compressed implementation
No geometry/LOD/convergence/performance improvement, plume-form change, Metal/WebGPU runtime execution or remote CI claim
